patterns.service_pattern: Services in lib/services/ return result objects with { success: boolean, data?: any, error?: string }
patterns.api_route_pattern: API routes follow: auth check → validation → business logic → response
patterns.supabase_client: Use createServerClient() from @supabase/ssr with cookie handling
patterns.existing_rate_limit: Service request uses database timestamp (last_ping_at) with 30s cooldown, returns 429 status
patterns.error_messages: All error messages are in Turkish
patterns.typescript_interfaces: Define request body and result types for each route

existing_implementations.description: Found existing rate limiting in /api/service-request using database-backed timestamp approach

pattern_details.check_logic: Compare current time with last request time
pattern_details.response: HTTP 429 with Turkish message showing remaining seconds
pattern_details.per_resource: Rate limit applied per table ID

rate_limiting_strategy.approach: Hybrid - use existing database pattern for per-user limits, add in-memory for global/IP limits
reasons: Database pattern already proven in codebase
In-memory Map sufficient for IP-based global limits (stateless Edge functions reset anyway)
rate_limiting_strategy.implementation_notes: Create reusable rate-limiter service that can work with both database storage (for authenticated users) and in-memory storage (for unauthenticated/IP-based)
